title: Full public expansion yields a pooled ZL tail but no added-page or cross-transcription confirmation under strict row constraints
statement: The same exact constrained multi-row enumeration was expanded from the previous34public evaluation pages to every page in pinned ZL (226) and IT (225). The added pages are the public practice training complement,192ZL/191IT pages, disjoint from the34within this diagnostic but used in earlier project work. All original row word multisets, exact positional word marginals within page/equal-token-width blocks, positional EVA-basic lengths and barriers remain fixed. The predeclared primary added-page sample has only32layouts/42movable adjacent pairs in ZL and8layouts/24pairs in IT, failing the frozen100-layout support gate in both editions (and the30-pair gate in IT). No primary p-value is reported. The secondary pooled sample has128layouts/58movable pairs in ZL and32layouts/40pairs in IT. ZL pooled Monte Carlo p is0.005 over199draws; a separately specified post-primary exhaustive-tail check gives1/128=0.0078125. IT pooled fails the100-layout gate; its descriptive exact tail is3/32=0.09375 and the smallest possible tail1/32=0.03125. Therefore this strict null has no primary added-page or cross-edition confirmation. A genuine irreducible3-row trade appears in ZL f54r lines9/10/11, exchanging or/ol at three exact columns while preserving every row inventory. IT splits initial oaiin into o aiin on line9, changing its width from12to13 and removing it from the same equal-width block; other spelling differences are retained. This explains the loss of this particular witness, not all cross-edition differences. Full enumeration completes everywhere, and an independent row-permutation/column-count oracle matches every added-page block (1212ZL/1183IT). Pooled support/mobility factorization with the prior34pages is verified. These are public diagnostics, not hidden results or language evidence. The original PR673 fact draft remains byte-identical and unpublished.
check: Do not turn the secondary pooled ZL tail into primary replication or a claim across transcriptions. Public ZL/IT page inventories in these pins are exhausted. The strict null is sparse and transcription-sensitive. Next work should preregister how to treat literal word-boundary disagreements or, separately, whether equal-token-width blocking is an extra restriction that can be relaxed while preserving row inventories, k marginals and positional lengths. Do not alter boundaries, strata, threshold or the frozen original PR673 fact after seeing these results. Human review/merge of trusted metric code remains required before any hidden fact submission.

"""Expand the public sample with unchanged exact multi-row constraints."""
import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT.parent/'edge-multirow'))
import run as search
PLAN={
 'question':'Does enlarging the public sample provide enough conditional movement under the same constraints?',
 'primary_sample':'Public practice training complement: all pages excluded from the earlier34-page practice evaluation sample. Disjoint page IDs within this diagnostic; these public pages have been used in earlier project work and are not fresh blind data.',
 'secondary_sample':'All public pages of each pinned edition, including the original34. Nested pooled sensitivity, not a second independent replication.',
 'editions':['zl','it'],
 'constraints':search.PLAN['constraints'],
 'blocks':search.PLAN['blocks'],
 'limits':search.PLAN['limits'],
 'decision':'Unchanged: complete enumeration in every block, >=100 global layouts, >=30 movable adjacent pairs, nonconstant null before reporting p. Primary replication requires p<=.01 in both editions of the added-page sample. If only pooled sample qualifies, label it pooled only.',
 'null':search.PLAN['null_if_testable'],
 'verification':'Independently enumerate per-row permutations and join column counts on all added-page blocks if the primary enumeration completes; compare exact layout sets. Reuse previously verified34-page blocks to check pooled support multiplication.',
 'scope':'No heldout seed or hidden split. Same-page equal-original-token-width blocks remain mandatory; no relaxation after outcomes. No hidden fact or semantic claim.',
 'fact_sha256':hashlib.sha256(search.FACT.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}

if __name__=='__main__':
    if '--plan' in sys.argv:
        ROOT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);(ROOT/'plan.json').write_text(json.dumps(PLAN,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
        print('Plan frozen');sys.exit()
    assert json.loads((ROOT/'plan.json').read_text())==PLAN
    output={'plan':PLAN,'selfcheck':search.selfcheck(),'results':{}}
    old=json.loads((ROOT.parent/'edge-multirow/results.json').read_text())['results']
    for ed in ('zl','it'):
        added,prior=search.corpus.split_pages('practice',ed);all_pages=list(search.corpus.pages(ed))
        ids_added={p.id for p in added};ids_prior={p.id for p in prior}
        assert not ids_added&ids_prior and ids_added|ids_prior=={p.id for p in all_pages}
        output['results'][ed]={'added_page_ids':sorted(ids_added),'prior_page_ids':sorted(ids_prior),
                               'added_pages':len(added),'prior_pages':len(prior),'pooled_pages':len(all_pages),'page_sets_disjoint':True}
        for name,pages in [('added',added),('pooled',all_pages)]:
            result=search.run(pages);output['results'][ed][name]=result
            print(ed,name,'pages',len(pages),{k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ('block_reports','irreducible_multirow_witnesses','permutation_values')},flush=True)
            (ROOT/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(output,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
        a=output['results'][ed]['added'];p=output['results'][ed]['pooled']
        if a['complete_full_fiber'] and p['complete_full_fiber']:
            assert int(p['distinct_layouts_or_lower_bound'])==int(a['distinct_layouts_or_lower_bound'])*int(old[ed]['distinct_layouts_or_lower_bound'])
            assert p['affected_adjacent_pairs']==a['affected_adjacent_pairs']+old[ed]['affected_adjacent_pairs']
            output['results'][ed]['pooled_factorization_verified']=True
    assert hashlib.sha256(search.FACT.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==PLAN['fact_sha256']
    output['fact_unchanged']=True
    (ROOT/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(output,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
